name: Simple Smart Business Hours Manager
author: Network Powerhouse

sections.description:
Simple Smart Business Hours Manager is the smartest and simplest business hours manager you will find.

Easily add unlimited locations and display your schedule using our responsive Weekly Hours shortcode. We also include real-time Open/Closed status badges that update automatically on your customer’s device without requiring a page reload.

Features:
* Unlimited Locations: Manage hours for as many stores as you want.
* Weekly Schedule Table: Clean, responsive hours table [ssbhm_weekly].
* Status Badge: Simple Open/Closed indicator [ssbhm_badge].
* Auto-Refresh: Status updates automatically on mobile without page reloads.

Upgrade to Pro for:
* Holiday Scheduler: Set specific dates to automatically close your store.
* Smart Status Buttons: Buttons that cycle through “Opening Soon”, “Open”, “Closing Soon”, and “Closed”.
* Card Widget: Beautiful hours card with integrated action buttons.
* Neon Signs: Digital neon Open/Closed signs.
* Advanced Customization: Change all text, colors, and button links.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/simple-smart-business-hours-manager directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the “Business Hours” menu to add locations and set hours.
  4. Use the shortcode [ssbhm_weekly] to display your hours.
